publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Humans in control of AI-aided decisions by 2035
entries.quote: By 2035, will smart machines, bots and systems powered by artificial intelligence be designed to allow humans to easily be in control of most tech-aided decision-making that is relevant to their lives?
entries.subject: AI and human agency

notes: One closed question from a non-random opt-in canvassing, followed by open-ended elaboration (not captured). Pew calls the results nonscientific and not projectable.
